milestones.name: Complete Main Story
milestones.note: Finish the standard ending first before pursuing 100% completion

milestones.name: Unlock True Ending
milestones.note: Complete The Crucible and defeat Shii to unlock the true ending

milestones.name: Tribute
milestones.note: Trophy: Collect all 12 Candles and take them to Asma

milestones.name: Now We Know
milestones.note: Trophy: Collect all 7 Curios and take them to Capucine

milestones.name: Out Of Stock
milestones.note: Trophy: Buy everything from Mel — requires all 3 Mel's Minions

milestones.name: Alchemist
milestones.note: Trophy: Crystallize 500 Nacre Droplets at once

milestones.name: Aerial Skirmish
milestones.note: Trophy: Defeat 3 enemies without touching the ground

milestones.name: Modifier Overload
milestones.note: Trophy: Open at least 100 modifier slots

zones.name: The Crucible
zones.note: Zone associated with unlocking the true ending; player must complete it and defeat Shii here

abilities.name: Modifiers
abilities.note: 42 total collectibles; required for trophy 'Fully Modded' and 'Modifier Overload'

abilities.name: Coating Components
abilities.note: 24 total collectibles; required for trophy 'Fully Shielded'

abilities.name: Allocation Matrix
abilities.note: Loadout system adjustable for exploration, combat, or platforming situations

abilities.name: Solid Nacre
abilities.note: Converted from Nacre Droplets; should be managed before dangerous encounters

abilities.name: Nacre Droplets
abilities.note: Primary currency/resource; 2000 needed for 'Greedy' trophy; 500 must be crystallized at once for 'Alchemist' trophy

bosses.name: Shii
bosses.note: Story boss (5 of 6); defeating Shii unlocks the true ending

bosses.name: Terror of the Ledge
bosses.note: Optional boss (8 of 13); further optional bosses not individually named in this segment
